central_idea_and_construction: A single organic abstract gesture for a calm focus app: a plump continuous purple form sweeps up from a wide soft base, bends gently left then opens into a broad rounded upper lobe. A deep open comma-shaped white bay enters from the right and terminates in a large round interior opening, giving the gesture room to breathe. The upper and lower ends remain separated by a generous gap; no closed ring, infinity, orbital path, arrowhead, leaf, letter f or generic spiral. One smooth filled silhouette with deliberate varying thickness, broad ends and few turning points. Centered 66% width, 69% height. Flat ink, no shading, grain, dot, sparkle or inner tile.
background_role: plain white negative space; no inset outer tile
material: flat ink / pixel clusters; no material rendering
small_size_signature: Broad white open bay and asymmetric outer contour.
specific_risk: Could resemble a generic spiral if the mouth narrows or wraps too far.
reference_transfer: Negative user screenshots analyzed as text: avoid severed slabs and nested squared Ls; no positive visual reference or borrowed signature.
observations: Recorded separately after viewing actual output.
